remarks: SELLER HAS REQUESTED HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY 5PM TUESDAY 10/1/24. Absolute turn-key perfection in this spectacularly private and stylish 3 bedroom 2.5 bath townhouse. Only the finest materials and finishes were selected to create a calm and soothing retreat. Spectacular new kitchen with Bosch appliances, a dedicated pantry and gleaming quartz counters - all open to the oversized living room and dining room combo with fireplace. The adjacent home office (or den) with sliders leads to a very spacious slate patio. The second floor boasts a large primary bedroom with a new en suite bath and 3 ample closets. You will also find two more spacious bedrooms upstairs, together with another fully updated hall bathroom and laundry. The large unfinished lower level might easily be converted to extra space, if desired, but offers generous storage as is. Enjoy the safety and convenience of your own one-car attached garage.  Lambert Commons offers an enviable location for commuters, close to shopping, restaurants and Metro North or the Merritt. GPS directions @ 11 Westport Road, Wilton
